newsitem.title: THAILAND: S-One buys into Christiani, Quality House.
newsitem.headline: S-One buys into Christiani, Quality House.

text.p: Thai broker Securities One Plc has bought stakes in construction firm Christiani and Neilsen (Thai) Plc and developer Quality Houses Plc, the firms said on Thursday.

Securities One bought 15.312 million shares or 9.23 percent of Quality House Plc through the Stock Exchange of Thailand on June 27, the developer said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand on Thursday.

Securities One also bought 26.89 million shares or 6.99 percent of Christiani on June 27, Christiani said in a similar statement. The purchase took Securities One's stake in Christiani to 7.03 percent, Christiani said.
Securities One executives were not immediately available for comment.
